The kernel trick in one line.src: The kernel trick in one line

A linear classifier learns $w$ such that.zh: 线性分类器学习 $w$，使得 $\mathrm{sign}(w^\top x)$ 预测出标签。对某个特征映射做替换 $x \to \phi(x)$，模型便成为 $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i \phi(x_i)^\top \phi(x) = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i k(x_i, x)$。你永远不需要显式地写出 $\phi$ —— 只需要核 $k(x, x') = \phi(x)^\top \phi(x')$。这就是核技巧。
A linear classifier learns $w$ such that.src:
A linear classifier learns $w$ such that $\mathrm{sign}(w^\top x)$
          predicts the label. Replace $x \to \phi(x)$ for some feature
          map; the model becomes
          $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i \phi(x_i)^\top \phi(x) = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i k(x_i, x)$.
          You never need $\phi$ explicitly — only the kernel
          $k(x, x') = \phi(x)^\top \phi(x')$. That's the kernel trick.

Two consequences. First, the runtime dep.zh: 由此有两个推论。其一，运行时间取决于训练点的数目 $N$，而非（往往无限的）特征维度。其二，你可以使用其特征映射 @@T0@@没有闭式形式@@T1@@ 的核 —— RBF 核 $k(x, x') = \exp(-\|x-x'\|^2 / 2h^2)$ 就对应一个无限维的高斯特征映射。
Two consequences. First, the runtime dep.src: Two consequences. First, the runtime depends on the number of training points $N$, not the (often infinite) feature dimension. Second, you can use kernels whose feature maps have no closed form — the RBF kernel $k(x, x') = \exp(-\|x-x'\|^2 / 2h^2)$ corresponds to an infinite-dimensional Gaussian feature map.

Not every symmetric function $k(x, x')$.src:
Not every symmetric function $k(x, x')$ is a kernel. The
          requirement: for any finite set of points $\{x_1, \dots,
          x_N\}$, the Gram matrix $K_{ij} = k(x_i, x_j)$ must be
          positive semi-definite. Mercer's theorem (1909) says such
          kernels admit a spectral decomposition

where $\\{\\lambda_i, \\psi_i\\}$ are ei.src: where $\{\lambda_i, \psi_i\}$ are eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the integral operator $(T_k f)(x) = \int k(x, x') f(x') \, d\mu(x')$. The map $\phi(x) = (\sqrt{\lambda_i}\,\psi_i(x))_i$ is the implicit feature map you never had to compute. Two practical rules follow:

@@T0@@Closure properties.@@T1@@ Sums, pr.zh: @@T0@@封闭性。@@T1@@ 核的和、积以及正标量倍数仍然是核。乘积空间上的 $k_1(x, x')\,k_2(z, z')$ 亦然。这正是你如何由基本核构造出表达力强的核（谱混合核、加性高斯过程）。
@@T0@@Closure properties.@@T1@@ Sums, pr.src: Closure properties. Sums, products, and positive scalar multiples of kernels are kernels. So is $k_1(x, x')\,k_2(z, z')$ on a product space. This is how you build expressive kernels from primitive ones (spectral mixture kernels, additive GPs).

@@T0@@Constructing new kernels.@@T1@@ If.zh: @@T0@@构造新核。@@T1@@ 若 $\phi$ 是 @@T2@@任意@@T3@@ 一个映入希尔伯特空间的映射，则 $k(x, x') = \langle \phi(x), \phi(x')\rangle$ 自动就是合法的核。图核、字符串核与卷积核都遵循这一范式。
@@T0@@Constructing new kernels.@@T1@@ If.src: Constructing new kernels. If $\phi$ is any map into a Hilbert space, $k(x, x') = \langle \phi(x), \phi(x')\rangle$ is automatically a valid kernel. Graph kernels, string kernels, and convolutional kernels all follow this template.

Why are all kernel-method solutions of t.src: Why are all kernel-method solutions of the form $f^\star = \sum_i \alpha_i k(x_i, \cdot)$? The representer theorem (Kimeldorf & Wahba, 1971): for any loss $L$ depending only on $\{f(x_i)\}$ and any monotone regulariser $\Omega(\|f\|_\mathcal{H})$, the minimiser of

over the RKHS $\\mathcal{H}$ associated.zh: 在与核 $k$ 相关联的 RKHS $\mathcal{H}$ 上取极小，其解落在有限维子空间 $\mathrm{span}\{k(x_i, \cdot)\}_{i=1}^N$ 之中。于是，这个无限维的变分问题简化为一个关于 $\alpha$ 的 $N$ 维问题 —— 这正是核方法为何易于处理的原因。
over the RKHS $\\mathcal{H}$ associated.src:
over the RKHS $\mathcal{H}$ associated with kernel $k$ lies in
          the finite-dimensional subspace
          $\mathrm{span}\{k(x_i, \cdot)\}_{i=1}^N$. So the infinite-dimensional
          variational problem reduces to an $N$-dimensional one in
          $\alpha$ — that's why kernel methods are tractable.

A practical rule of thumb: @@T0@@bandwid.zh: 一条实用的经验法则：@@T0@@带宽 $h$ ≈ 数据点之间距离的中位数@@T1@@。「中位数启发式」是一个很强的默认值，也是超参数搜索的起点。对于多项式核，如果你确实想要特征交互，更宜采用显式特征展开；而对于类神经网络的非线性，更宜采用 RBF 或 Matérn。
A practical rule of thumb: @@T0@@bandwid.src: A practical rule of thumb: bandwidth $h$ ≈ median distance between points. The "median heuristic" is a strong default and the starting point for hyperparameter search. For the polynomial kernel, prefer the explicit feature expansion if you actually want feature interactions; for neural-net-like nonlinearities, prefer RBF or Matérn.

The kernel-GP-SVM trinity.zh: 核–高斯过程–SVM 三位一体

The same kernel gives you three differen.zh: 同一个核为你带来三种不同的方法。
The same kernel gives you three differen.src: The same kernel gives you three different methods.

@@T0@@Kernel ridge regression.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@核岭回归。@@T1@@
            $\hat\alpha = (K + \lambda I)^{-1} y$；预测 $\hat f(x) = \sum_i \hat\alpha_i k(x_i, x)$。有闭式解，拟合需 $O(N^3)$，预测需 $O(N)$。
@@T0@@Kernel ridge regression.@@T1@@\n.src: Kernel ridge regression. $\hat\alpha = (K + \lambda I)^{-1} y$; prediction $\hat f(x) = \sum_i \hat\alpha_i k(x_i, x)$. Closed form, $O(N^3)$ to fit, $O(N)$ to predict.

@@T0@@Gaussian process regression.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@高斯过程回归。@@T1@@ 在 $\lambda = \sigma^2$（噪声方差）时，其点估计与核岭回归相同，@@T2@@此外@@T3@@ 还给出闭式的预测方差 $\sigma_*^2 = k(x_*, x_*) - k_*^\top (K + \sigma^2 I)^{-1} k_*$。这就是人们所说的「免费获得校准良好的不确定性」。
@@T0@@Gaussian process regression.@@T1@@.src: Gaussian process regression. Same point estimate as kernel ridge with $\lambda = \sigma^2$ (noise variance), plus a closed-form predictive variance $\sigma_*^2 = k(x_*, x_*) - k_*^\top (K + \sigma^2 I)^{-1} k_*$. That's the "calibrated uncertainty for free" people talk about.

@@T0@@SVM.@@T1@@ Same kernel, different.zh: @@T0@@SVM。@@T1@@ 相同的核，不同的损失（用合页损失替代平方误差）。其对偶问题归结为一个关于 $\alpha$ 的二次规划；起作用的约束挑出「支持向量」—— 通常只是训练集的一个稀疏子集。
@@T0@@SVM.@@T1@@ Same kernel, different.src: SVM. Same kernel, different loss (hinge instead of squared error). The dual reduces to a QP in $\alpha$; the active constraints pick out the "support vectors" — usually a sparse subset of the training set.

Mental model: @@T0@@kernel ridge = MAP G.zh: 思维模型：@@T0@@核岭回归 = 最大后验高斯过程。SVM = 最大间隔变体。@@T1@@ 二者都在同一个核之上加入了一种不同的要素（贝叶斯后验、稀疏性）。
Mental model: @@T0@@kernel ridge = MAP G.src: Mental model: kernel ridge = MAP GP. SVM = max-margin variant. Each adds a different ingredient (Bayesian posterior, sparsity) on top of the same kernel.

@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@ The NTK gi.zh: @@T0@@为何这很重要。@@T1@@ NTK 提供了深度学习中心见的 @@T2@@理论@@T3@@ 结论：对过参数化网络的行为给出闭式预测。它有局限（真正的深度学习会学习特征；NTK 不会），但它解释了大量在实践中出现的双下降、泛化与优化行为。
@@T0@@Why this matters.@@T1@@ The NTK gi.src: Why this matters. The NTK gives a rare-for-DL piece of theory: a closed-form prediction for what an over-parameterised network does. It has limits (real DL learns features; NTK does not), but it explains a lot of double-descent, generalisation, and optimisation behaviour seen in practice.

Scaling kernels past $N \\approx 10^4$.zh: 将核方法扩展到 $N \approx 10^4$ 以上

The $O(N^3)$ fit and $O(N^2)$ memory of.zh: 当数据点超过约 1 万时，原始核方法 $O(N^3)$ 的拟合与 $O(N^2)$ 的内存开销便不再实用。四条标准的出路：
The $O(N^3)$ fit and $O(N^2)$ memory of.src:
The $O(N^3)$ fit and $O(N^2)$ memory of vanilla kernel methods
          stop being practical above ~10k points. Four standard
          escapes:

@@T0@@Random Fourier features.@@T1@@ App.zh: @@T0@@随机傅里叶特征。@@T1@@ 通过从核的傅里叶变换中采样频率来近似平移不变核：$k(x, x') \approx z(x)^\top z(x')$，其中对小 $D$ 有 $z(x) \in \mathbb{R}^D$（Rahimi & Recht，2007）。这归结为 $D$ 维上的普通岭回归 —— 拟合需 $O(NDB)$。
@@T0@@Random Fourier features.@@T1@@ App.src: Random Fourier features. Approximate shift-invariant kernels by sampling frequencies from the kernel's Fourier transform: $k(x, x') \approx z(x)^\top z(x')$ with $z(x) \in \mathbb{R}^D$ for small $D$ (Rahimi & Recht, 2007). Reduces to ordinary ridge in $D$ dimensions — $O(NDB)$ to fit.

@@T0@@Nyström approximation.@@T1@@ Pick.zh: @@T0@@Nyström 近似。@@T1@@ 选取 $M \ll N$ 个地标点；用低秩分解近似 $K$。应用于 scikit-learn 的 @@T2@@Nystroem@@T3@@ 中。
@@T0@@Nyström approximation.@@T1@@ Pick.src: Nyström approximation. Pick $M \ll N$ landmark points; approximate $K$ by a low-rank factorisation. Used in scikit-learn's Nystroem.

@@T0@@Inducing-point GPs (SVGP).@@T1@@ V.zh: @@T0@@诱导点高斯过程（SVGP）。@@T1@@ 含 $M$ 个诱导位置的变分稀疏高斯过程；训练需 $O(NM^2)$。是高斯过程库（GPflow、GPyTorch）的默认方案。
@@T0@@Inducing-point GPs (SVGP).@@T1@@ V.src: Inducing-point GPs (SVGP). Variational sparse GPs with $M$ inducing locations; $O(NM^2)$ training. Default for GP libraries (GPflow, GPyTorch).

@@T0@@KeOps / structured kernel interpol.zh: @@T0@@KeOps / 结构化核插值。@@T1@@ 对百万级数据点进行 GPU 友好的精确核计算；在 2022–2024 年间已成熟，用于大数据上的「精确」高斯过程。
@@T0@@KeOps / structured kernel interpol.src: KeOps / structured kernel interpolation. GPU-friendly exact kernel evaluations on millions of points; mature in 2022–2024 for "exact" GPs on large data.

Why not the best of both worlds — let a.zh: 为何不兼取两者之长 —— 让神经网络学习一个特征映射 $\phi_\theta$，再将其送入一个核？
Why not the best of both worlds — let a.src:
Why not the best of both worlds — let a neural net learn a
          feature map $\phi_\theta$ and feed that into a kernel?

Train $\\theta$ jointly with the GP marg.zh: 以高斯过程的边缘似然为目标联合训练 $\theta$（Wilson 等，2016）。神经网络部分学习表示；高斯过程部分给出校准良好的不确定性。在 2024–2026 年间，对于校准良好的误差条至关重要的表格数据与小数据回归任务，这是默认方案 —— 在大多数小型表格回归数据集的正面基准对比中胜过深度集成。
Train $\\theta$ jointly with the GP marg.src:
Train $\theta$ jointly with the GP marginal likelihood
          (Wilson et al., 2016). The neural part learns
          representations; the GP part gives calibrated uncertainty.
          In 2024–2026 this is the default for tabular and small-data
          regression tasks where well-calibrated error bars matter — beats
          deep ensembles in head-to-head benchmarks on most small tabular
          regression datasets.

@@T0@@Watch out for collapsing $\\phi_\\.zh: @@T0@@当心 $\phi_\theta$ 塌缩。@@T1@@ 若特征维度非常小，$\phi_\theta$ 可能塌缩为一个常数；请用一个固定范数的输出层来正则化，或采用 SVGP 式的变分训练。
@@T0@@Watch out for collapsing $\\phi_\\.src: Watch out for collapsing $\phi_\theta$. If the feature dimension is very small, $\phi_\theta$ can collapse to a constant; regularise with a fixed-norm output layer or use SVGP-style variational training.

Where kernel methods are still the right.zh: 核方法依然是正确工具的场合
Where kernel methods are still the right.src: Where kernel methods are still the right tool

@@T0@@Small-data regression with calibra.zh: @@T0@@带校准不确定度量化的少数据回归。@@T1@@ 在 $\le 1k$ 个训练点上，带 RBF 核的高斯过程胜过深度网络，并免费给出有原理依据的误差条。直接适用于传感器校准、硬件设计、湿实验。
@@T0@@Small-data regression with calibra.src: Small-data regression with calibrated UQ. A GP with an RBF kernel beats a deep net on $\le 1k$ training points and gives you principled error bars for free. Direct fit for sensor calibration, hardware design, wet-lab.

@@T0@@Deep kernel learning.@@T1@@ $k(x,.zh: @@T0@@深度核学习。@@T1@@ $k(x, x') = k_{\text{RBF}}(\phi_\theta(x), \phi_\theta(x'))$，其中 $\phi_\theta$ 是一个联合训练的神经特征提取器。两者之长兼得；在表格数据与时间序列上表现良好。
@@T0@@Deep kernel learning.@@T1@@ $k(x,.src: Deep kernel learning. $k(x, x') = k_{\text{RBF}}(\phi_\theta(x), \phi_\theta(x'))$ where $\phi_\theta$ is a neural feature extractor learned jointly. Best of both worlds; works well on tabular and time-series.

@@T0@@NTK / NNGP regression.@@T1@@ When.zh: @@T0@@NTK / NNGP 回归。@@T1@@ 当你 @@T2@@需要@@T3@@ 无限宽度极限的预测时（例如用于理论或作为基线），在 @@T4@@jax@@T5@@ 中通过 @@T6@@neural-tangents@@T7@@ 实现 NTK 回归器只需一行代码。
@@T0@@NTK / NNGP regression.@@T1@@ When.src: NTK / NNGP regression. When you want the infinite-width limit's prediction (e.g. for theory or as a baseline), the NTK regressor is a line of code in jax via neural-tangents.

@@T0@@Spectral methods on graphs.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@图上的谱方法。@@T1@@ 用于分子性质预测、引文网络、传感器拓扑的图核。在小型图数据集上常常胜过 GNN。
@@T0@@Spectral methods on graphs.@@T1@@.src: Spectral methods on graphs. Graph kernels for molecule property prediction, citation networks, sensor topologies. Often beat GNNs on small graph datasets.

@@T0@@Standardise the inputs.@@T1@@ RBF.zh: @@T0@@对输入做标准化。@@T1@@ RBF / Matérn 对尺度极其敏感。在计算成对距离之前，先将每个特征标准化为单位方差，否则你的带宽调校将是错误的。
@@T0@@Standardise the inputs.@@T1@@ RBF.src: Standardise the inputs. RBF / Matérn are extremely scale-sensitive. Standardise each feature to unit variance before computing pairwise distances or your bandwidth tuning will be wrong.

@@T0@@Tune the regulariser.@@T1@@ $\\lam.zh: @@T0@@调校正则项。@@T1@@ 核岭回归中的 $\lambda$ / 高斯过程中的 $\sigma^2$ / SVM 中的 $C$，其重要性与核的选择不相上下。请在按对数间隔的网格上使用交叉验证。
@@T0@@Tune the regulariser.@@T1@@ $\\lam.src: Tune the regulariser. $\lambda$ in kernel ridge / $\sigma^2$ in GP / $C$ in SVM matter as much as the kernel choice. Use cross-validation on log-spaced grids.

@@T0@@Nyström samples should be diverse..zh: @@T0@@Nyström 样本应当多样。@@T1@@ 均匀随机地选取地标点会把容量浪费在某个簇上。k-means 地标或杠杆分数采样更好。
@@T0@@Nyström samples should be diverse..src: Nyström samples should be diverse. Uniform-random landmark selection wastes capacity on a cluster. k-means landmarks or leverage-score sampling are better.

@@T0@@Numerical stability.@@T1@@ $K + \\.zh: @@T0@@数值稳定性。@@T1@@ $K + \lambda I$ 可能病态；在 Cholesky 分解之前用 $\varepsilon I$（$\varepsilon \sim 10^{-6}$）做抖动。
@@T0@@Numerical stability.@@T1@@ $K + \\.src: Numerical stability. $K + \lambda I$ can be ill-conditioned; jitter with $\varepsilon I$ ($\varepsilon \sim 10^{-6}$) before Cholesky.

@@T0@@When to @@T1@@not@@T2@@ use kernel.zh: @@T0@@何时 @@T1@@不@@T2@@ 该用核方法。@@T3@@ 大型数据集（$\ge 10^5$ 个原始数据点），以及表示学习比不确定性校准更重要的图像 / 音频 / 语言输入 —— 请选择深度网络，并接受校准的代价（或事后做温度缩放）。
@@T0@@When to @@T1@@not@@T2@@ use kernel.src: When to not use kernels. Large datasets ($\ge 10^5$ raw points), image / audio / language inputs where representation learning matters more than uncertainty calibration — go with deep nets and accept the calibration cost (or post-hoc temperature-scale).

meta.title: 核方法，以及深度学习为何关心它
meta.tagline: 从 SVM 核到神经正切核 —— 连接经典机器学习与深度网络的那条主线
meta.summary: 把数据点点击到二维平面上；选择 RBF / 多项式 / 拉普拉斯核；观察核 SVM 的决策边界如何随核及其超参数而变化。随后认识神经正切核 —— 一个无限宽神经网络在线性化极限下所对应的核。最后是深度核学习这一实用的混合方案。
highlights: 用 RBF / 多项式 / 拉普拉斯 / 线性核进行实时的点击添加式分类。
带宽与次数滑块，让你体会核的平滑度旋钮。
NTK 面板：宽度 →∞ 的 1 隐藏层网络表现得如同一个核回归器 —— 与实际有限宽度网络并排可视化。
深度核学习处于什么位置，又在何处大放异彩（少数据校准回归）。
